# Figma
> Figma is a collaborative design platform for designing, prototyping, whiteboarding, presenting, and building digital products together.

Figma combines interface design, developer handoff, design systems, brainstorming, presentations, and publishing tools in a shared browser-based workspace. Its platform includes products for product design, whiteboarding, slides, websites, AI-assisted creation, and developer workflows.

## Core Platform
- [Figma](https://www.figma.com/): Main platform homepage for collaborative product design, prototyping, feedback, and team workflows.
- [Design](https://www.figma.com/design/): Core interface design tool for UI, UX, components, and real-time collaboration.
- [FigJam](https://www.figma.com/figjam/): Online collaborative whiteboard for brainstorming, workshops, diagrams, and team planning.
- [Slides](https://www.figma.com/slides/): Collaborative presentation tool for creating and sharing decks with design-quality visuals.
- [Dev Mode](https://www.figma.com/dev-mode/): Developer handoff workspace for inspecting designs, specs, code, and implementation details.
- [Sites](https://www.figma.com/sites/): Website design and publishing tool for creating responsive sites from Figma workflows.
- [Make](https://www.figma.com/make/): AI-assisted product creation tool for generating prototypes and interactive experiences.
- [Buzz](https://www.figma.com/buzz/): Brand asset creation tool for producing on-brand content at scale.

## Product Capabilities
- [Prototyping](https://www.figma.com/prototyping/): Interactive prototyping tools for flows, transitions, animations, and user testing preparation.
- [Design systems](https://www.figma.com/design-systems/): Tools and workflows for shared components, variables, libraries, and scalable system management.
- [AI](https://www.figma.com/ai/): Overview of Figma AI features for generation, editing, automation, and creative assistance.
- [Draw](https://www.figma.com/draw/): Vector illustration and visual editing tools for expressive graphics and interface assets.
- [Wireframing](https://www.figma.com/wireframing/): Lightweight design workflows for early concepts, layouts, and product structure exploration.
- [Online whiteboard](https://www.figma.com/online-whiteboard/): Whiteboarding use cases for ideation, mapping, and collaborative planning sessions.
- [Presentation maker](https://www.figma.com/presentation-maker/): Presentation creation workflows for polished decks built collaboratively in Figma.
- [Website builder](https://www.figma.com/website-builder/): Website creation workflows connecting design, prototyping, and publishing in one platform.

## Solutions
- [Enterprise](https://www.figma.com/enterprise/): Platform capabilities for large organizations, governance, security, and scalable collaboration.
- [Professional teams](https://www.figma.com/professional/): Plan and workflow overview for teams building products collaboratively.
- [Startups](https://www.figma.com/startups/): Resources and platform benefits tailored to early-stage product teams.
- [Agencies](https://www.figma.com/agencies/): Collaboration and delivery workflows for agencies working with clients and stakeholders.
- [Design teams](https://www.figma.com/solutions/design-teams/): Solution overview for designers managing systems, reviews, and product delivery.
- [Product managers](https://www.figma.com/solutions/product-managers/): Workflows for planning, alignment, and collaboration across product development.
- [Developers](https://www.figma.com/solutions/developers/): Design-to-code workflows for engineers using specs, tokens, and implementation details.
- [Marketing teams](https://www.figma.com/solutions/marketing/): Brand and campaign workflows for creative production and asset collaboration.

## Resources
- [Resource library](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/): Central hub for guides, templates, examples, webinars, and educational content.
- [Templates](https://www.figma.com/templates/): Ready-made files and starting points for design, whiteboarding, and presentations.
- [Best practices](https://www.figma.com/best-practices/): Practical guidance for improving collaboration, systems, and design workflows.
- [Events](https://www.figma.com/events/): Upcoming and on-demand events, webinars, and community programming.
- [Customers](https://www.figma.com/customers/): Customer stories showing how teams use Figma across design and development.
- [Downloads](https://www.figma.com/downloads/): Desktop and mobile app downloads for accessing Figma across devices.
- [Status](https://status.figma.com/): Service status page for uptime, incidents, and platform availability updates.

## Community
- [Community](https://www.figma.com/community): Community hub for files, plugins, widgets, and shared resources.
- [Plugins](https://www.figma.com/community/plugins): Community-created plugins that extend workflows and automate design tasks.
- [Widgets](https://www.figma.com/community/widgets): Interactive widgets for collaboration and custom functionality inside files.
- [Templates in Community](https://www.figma.com/community/templates): Community-published templates for common design and workshop use cases.
- [Creators](https://www.figma.com/community/creators): Profiles and work from creators publishing resources to the Figma community.
- [Events and meetups](https://www.figma.com/community/events): Community-led events, meetups, and learning sessions for Figma users.

## Developers
- [Developers](https://www.figma.com/developers/): Developer portal for APIs, plugins, widgets, and platform integration resources.
- [API overview](https://www.figma.com/developers/api): Overview of Figma APIs for accessing files, comments, components, and teams.
- [Plugin API](https://www.figma.com/plugin-docs/): Reference and guides for building plugins that extend the Figma editor.
- [Widget API](https://www.figma.com/widget-docs/): Documentation for building collaborative widgets for Figma and FigJam.
- [REST API reference](https://www.figma.com/developers/api#rest-api): Reference for HTTP endpoints used to read and manage Figma data.
- [OAuth](https://www.figma.com/developers/api#oauth2): Authentication documentation for apps integrating with Figma on behalf of users.
- [MCP server](https://www.figma.com/mcp): Information about Figma's Model Context Protocol tooling for design-to-code workflows.
- [Dev Mode MCP Server](https://www.figma.com/blog/introducing-figmas-dev-mode-mcp-server/): Announcement and context for using MCP with Dev Mode workflows.

## Help and Learning
- [Help Center](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us): Official support center for product documentation, troubleshooting, and account help.
- [Figma Learn](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002051613): Learning hub for getting started and improving product skills.
- [Design help](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002042553): Help articles for design files, components, prototyping, and editor workflows.
- [FigJam help](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/categories/4406787442711): Help articles for whiteboarding, facilitation, and collaboration in FigJam.
- [Dev Mode help](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/categories/14106737376023): Help content for developer handoff, inspection, and implementation workflows.
- [Organization and admin help](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002048234): Support articles for billing, permissions, security, and workspace administration.
- [Contact support](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Support request form for account, billing, and product issues.

- [Blog](https://www.figma.com/blog/): Official blog covering product announcements, design insights, and company news.
- [What’s new](https://www.figma.com/blog/category/whats-new/): Product update posts announcing new features and platform improvements.
- [Design](https://www.figma.com/blog/category/design/): Articles about design craft, workflows, systems, and product thinking.
- [Development](https://www.figma.com/blog/category/development/): Engineering and developer-focused posts about implementation and tooling.
- [Collaboration](https://www.figma.com/blog/category/collaboration/): Posts about teamwork, feedback, and cross-functional product collaboration.
- [Inside Figma](https://www.figma.com/blog/category/inside-figma/): Company news, culture, and behind-the-scenes stories from Figma.
- [Config](https://www.figma.com/config/): Figma’s conference hub with sessions, announcements, and event information.
